dialogs.about: 사위와 함께 집 안 안전을 점검해요

lines.en: Mother, let's inspect the house today.
Good idea. Where do we start?
The kitchen. Is the gas valve closed?
Yes, I closed it this morning.
The burner made a spark last week.
Oh! Please unplug the old microwave.
lines.ko: 어머! 오래된 전자레인지 플러그를 뽑아 주세요.

lines.en: Done. Is the fire extinguisher here?
It's beside the door, near the stairs.
Good. People slip on those stairs sometimes.
I will hold the railing. Thank you.

dialogs.about: 아파트 안전 점검원이 와서 집을 점검해요

lines.en: Good afternoon. I am inspecting the apartments today.
Please come in. Where do you begin?
First the kitchen. Does the burner work well?
Yes, but it sparked once last month.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 지난달에 한 번 불꽃이 튀었어요.

lines.en: Then please unplug it before you leave.
lines.ko: 그러면 나가실 때 플러그를 뽑아 두세요.

lines.en: I will. Is our fire detector good?
lines.ko: 그럴게요. 우리 집 화재 감지기는 괜찮아요?

lines.en: It works well. Do you have an extinguisher?
Yes, in the hallway beside the stairs.
Good. Close the gas valve every night.
Thank you. I will check the railing too.
